name: How are utilities and climate control handled for a granny apartment?
description: Plumbing and electrical lines tie into existing infrastructure or upgraded panels, while independent mini-split systems provide efficient, personalized heating

mainEntity.name: How are utilities and climate control handled for a granny apartment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Homeowners must assess their plumbing capacity, electrical panel load, and HVAC requirements before building a self-contained suite. A dedicated bathroom, kitchenette, and laundry line demand proper drainage slopes and adequate water supply tie-ins. The main electrical service panel must have sufficient breaker space to support new lighting, appliances, and air conditioning without overload. Heating and cooling are often addressed with independent ductless mini-split systems, which allow the suite resident to control their own room temperature without overtaxing the primary home's central HVAC unit.
acceptedAnswer.description: Plumbing and electrical lines tie into existing infrastructure or upgraded panels, while independent mini-split systems provide efficient, personalized heating and cooling.
